description: Reception sticker-book skill set — intended to map to existing platform skills (skills_key). If a skill is not found it will be reported by the attach script.

skills.name: Attention
skills.notes: Focus on short tasks and instructions

skills.name: Working Memory
skills.notes: Hold information for a short time (e.g., remember a 2-step instruction)

skills.name: Fine Motor Skills
skills.notes: Use scissors, crayons, and manipulate small objects

skills.name: Following Protocols
skills.notes: Follow simple classroom routines and rules

skills.name: Social Confidence
skills.notes: Approach peers and adults; participate in group play

skills.name: Speaking
skills.notes: Use sentences to express needs and ideas

skills.name: Vocabulary
skills.notes: Use and understand a growing range of words

skills.name: Non-verbal communication
skills.notes: Use gestures, eye contact and facial expressions appropriately

skills.name: Self-regulation
skills.notes: Manage emotions and behaviour in class situations

skills.name: Empathy
skills.notes: Recognise and respond to others' feelings
